hunks.baseline: The moment I heard that clear, bright voice—the last thing I’d expected—instinct surged ahead of thought and took over my whole body.

hunks.baseline: My figure blurred. I closed the distance of three zhang in an instant, thrusting out my hand as instinct commanded.
hunks.sol: I blurred into motion, closing the three-zhang gap in an instant. My hand shot out, obeying instinct.

hunks.baseline: Toward that snow-white neck.
hunks.sol: Toward her snow-white neck.

hunks.sol: The wind arrived a beat behind me. Her silken hair flew about her face in the rush of air.

hunks.baseline: At the last moment, I pushed back against instinct and stopped my hand in midair. Then I stared at the familiar face before me.
hunks.sol: At the last moment, I fought down my instincts and stopped my hand in midair. I stared at the familiar face before me.

hunks.baseline: And asked,
The woman who answered calmly—So Gyo—glanced at my hand, halted just in front of her throat.
hunks.sol: So Gyo glanced at my hand, halted just in front of her throat.

hunks.baseline: “To strike so suddenly, without warning. You’re as rash as you look.”
hunks.sol: “Striking out of nowhere like that. You’re as rash as you look.”

hunks.baseline: “I think you meant ‘more rash than I look.’”
hunks.sol: “I think you mean *more* rash than I look.”

hunks.baseline: “In this case, I think I said it right. More importantly, when are you planning to move that threatening hand?”
hunks.sol: “No, I think I had it right. Now, when do you plan to move that menacing hand?”

hunks.baseline: “Sure?”
hunks.sol: “Sure of what?”

hunks.baseline: Only then did I feel my heartbeat begin to settle.
hunks.sol: Only then did my heartbeat begin to settle.

I’d been so lost in thought that I hadn’t even realized someone was nearby. Even if I’d walked right into a trap, I’d have had no excuse.

hunks.baseline: *More importantly… why is she here?*
hunks.sol: *But why is she here?*

hunks.baseline: That made no sense.

hunks.sol: “A place in the imperial palace no one wants to enter, and everyone keeps quiet about.”

hunks.sol: “Do you not know the difference between *won’t* and *can’t*?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you here?”
hunks.sol: “Why are *you* here?”

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t make sense of it.
Why had So Gyo, one of the Emperor’s trusted followers, come to a place that might as well have been the Emperor’s greatest sore spot?

hunks.baseline: “Could it be…?”

hunks.baseline: “Then what is it?”
hunks.sol: “Then why are you here?”

hunks.baseline: I was at a loss for words and could only smack my lips. Then So Gyo, who had been watching me with composed eyes, suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: I had no answer. As I stood there trying to think of one, So Gyo spoke again.

hunks.baseline: “If you answer one question honestly, I might tell you why I’m here.”
hunks.sol: “Answer one question honestly, and I might tell you.”

hunks.baseline: What the hell was this woman?
hunks.sol: What the hell was this woman after?

hunks.baseline: “In exchange, can I ask you something else?”
hunks.sol: “Can I ask you something else instead?”
